content.value: What is strain gauge? A compressive force is applied to a structural member. The strain is 5 mircro-strain. Two separate strain gauges are attached to the structural member, one is a nickel wire strain gauge having a gauge factor of -12.1 and the other is nichrome wire strain gauge having a gauge factor of 2. Calculate the value of resistance of the gauges after they are strained. The resistance of strain gauges before being strained is 120Ω.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
